Subject: SIG request for marketplace procurement

Hi Evelyn,

We're preparing our marketplace procurement packet for Acme Health's platform team. Legal asked if Redwood can provide the completed SIG and the supporting evidence bundle (PDF export + manifest) uploaded directly to Whistic and OneTrust. Specific asks:
- A single flattened PDF for the Whistic portal (max 50MB if possible)
- A split export (control groups as separate PDFs) for OneTrust to attach to the procurement record
- An evidence index CSV mapping attachments to SIG controls
- SHA256 checksums for each file

Can you confirm turnaround and whether you need any procurement forms from our side?

Thanks,
Maya R.
Procurement Lead, Acme Health
procureops@acmehealth.com

Hi Maya — thanks for the list. We can do both upload formats. High-level plan:

1) Produce a master PDF export that is flattened and bookmarked for Whistic (single file).
2) Produce split PDFs by control group (e.g., Logical, Physical, Organizational) for OneTrust — these will be named with sequence prefixes so the marketplace can present them in the required order.
3) Generate an evidence_index CSV that maps each attachment filename to SIG control IDs and to the pages within the PDFs.
4) Produce a checksum_manifest (SHA256) for each file and include that in the upload notes.

Two quick questions before we finalize:
- Do you have a strict filename convention for the marketplace (some customers require a numeric prefix like 01_02_03)?
- Any need for DocuSign or stamped PDFs for procurement acceptance?

I'll attach the index and checksum once Monica runs the export. ETA: EOD today for the initial exports, EOD +1 for uploads if no procurement forms are required.

Evelyn Hart

Adding the export details from the evidence team. Points covered:

- PDF handling: we'll flatten all PDFs, embed bookmarks (top-level control groups), and remove hidden metadata. 
- Pagination: we'll add a small footer with page stamps in the form REDWOOD_SIG_YYYYMMDD - page X of Y so the evidence_index can point to specific pages.
- Split logic: control group boundaries will be respected; splits will be named using a three-digit sequence prefix (e.g., 001-AdministrativeControls.pdf, 002-TechnicalControls.pdf) unless Acme requests a different scheme.
- Attachments: attaching the evidence index and checksum manifest for your review.

Upload plan and portal notes (technical):

Whistic:
- Accepts single PDF per submission; size limit ~50MB. We'll use the master flattened PDF.
- Recommended filename: REDWOOD_SIG_20261122_Whistic.pdf
- Include checksum_manifest and evidence_index in the description field rather than as separate attachments to ensure portability.

OneTrust:
- OneTrust record prefers smaller PDFs attached per control group. We'll upload the split PDFs using the numeric prefix Monica suggested.
- OneTrust sometimes strips bookmarks; we'll include an internal index CSV and a top-level index PDF that maps control IDs to file names and pages.

Marketplace (Acme's) notes:
- For their marketplace listing, they prefer numeric sequencing in filenames so their ingestion script preserves ordering. We'll use 001_, 002_, etc. for the split files.
- HubSpot procurement record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-7241 (internal link)

I'll do a dry run upload to our staging Whistic org first and share the link for Acme to review before the final submission.

-Karthik
Head of Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
